about: The files this site's executor must be found to run before a result from it is accepted, for dodona's own checks. This is NOT dodona's lock: the lock (protocol/lock.schema.json) pins whole tool trees by a digest verified against what upstream publishes, and nothing computes that yet. `sha256` is the digest the executor must measure for the file, and `basis` says where that digest came from; null would mean not pinned, and nothing recorded in that state ever counts. The Java runtime is whatever the executor's system provides; `system` is not a version, and pinning its launcher file says little about the runtime. A tool with a `floor` instead of a `sha256` is accepted at that version or any later one, as the queue's owner decided for its Java runtime (2026-11-20): the executor reads the version it runs and records its digest, and a result's key holds the floor, so a newer build of the tool does not make results stale.

tools.name: java
tools.basis: The queue's owner keeps no exact Java build: the current one and newer must work (lobby message, 2026-11-20). Java 21 at the pinned path is accepted from 21.0.13 on; each run records the build it measured. The launcher measured before, 8b0b1959..., was 21.0.13.0.3.

tools.name: tla2tools
tools.basis: Measured on the executor in CI run 44201829244 and equal, byte for byte, to tla2tools.jar of the upstream release v1.7.4 (github.com/tlaplus/tlaplus), downloaded and hashed on 2026-11-18.
